newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.
newsitem.headline: CWB details Prairie elevator space, railcar unload.

text.p: Vacant space in Canadian Prairie primary elevators increased to 32 percent in the week ended May 25 while railcar unloads exceeded targets in Thunder Bay, Canadian Wheat Board said.
The average vacancy in Prairie elevators was 32 percent, up from 27 percent on May 18, it said.
Alberta had the most space available at 33 percent, followed by Manitoba at 32 percent and Saskatchewan at 31 percent.
Vancouver unloaded 2,669 railcars versus the 2,830 target. Prince Rupert unloaded 1,061 railcars versus the 1,115 target.
Thunder Bay unloaded 3,226 railcars versus the 2,460 hopper car target.
